title: Concept: renv package restored from a non-repository source
description: renv.lock declares a package whose `Source` is a code host rather than a repository, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a package whose `Source` is a code host rather than a repository.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through renv.lock (cran).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a package whose `Source` is a code host rather than a repository.
